_meta.what: adjusted-close to raw-close ratio, sampled at every point the ratio moves
_meta.why: data/prices/*.csv stores adjusted close only. Dividing by this ratio gives the raw close, so a chart can show total return and price return side by side without storing a second full price series.
_meta.use: ratio is flat between ex-dividend dates: for a date D take the last step whose day <= D, then close = adj_close / ratio
_meta.source: Yahoo Finance chart endpoint, daily bars
